steps.content: [Foot of the Mountain]

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, we've received a response from Eastia. They've declined to investigate the codex further. Officially, the mission is complete. My safety assessment remains unchanged: returning to the manor is not advised.
Upon waking, Schorl resumes the earlier conversation, yet the Chief is absent. Only Xiaofeng is there, perched lazily upon a mound of snow.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Quit your scanning. That Chief of yours is long gone. That one's set on finding out where that codex came from, and what that girl's really burning herself up for.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...The personal motivations of Northsnow Manor's master fall outside this investigation's operational parameters.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: He knows. That wasn't a request for input. That was a heads-up.
steps.female_content: She knows. That wasn't a request for input. That was a heads-up.

steps.speaker: Xiaofeng
steps.content: Aww. Look at you, little black lump, all alone. Your master ran off and left you. How about you come with me instead? I bet you'd make a great new toy for Meowy to bat around.
Xiaofeng withholds your parting words from Schorl. There is no purpose in relaying them, as the outcome remains the same either way.

Northwild stands independent from Eastia, its foundation built on heroic ideals. Shuang'er told so many tales of the martial world and legendary heroes in Ping'an Town... If the townspeople knew what happened at Northsnow Manor, perhaps some of them might still harbor enough heroic spirit to offer their aid...
Xiaofeng knows, deep down, that you are embarking on a path both naive and doomed to fail. Yet it is also the last hope for aid you can count on in this place.
[Foot of the Mountain]

Deathly silence grips the town. Heavy snow has collapsed half the rooftops, and not a single soul stirs in the streets. You approach the nearest courtyard, one of the few that remains relatively intact, its wooden gate standing firmly shut.
After a long moment, a cloudy eye peers out from the crack in the door.
Excuse me, sir. I'm sorry to bother you. I need to get to Northsnow Manor. Is the path up the mountain still passable?

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Cough, cough... Northsnow Manor? Up on Mount Fuyun? That place is a block of ice this time of year... icicles hanging down like teeth. What in the blazes would you want up there for? Alone?
The door creaks open halfway, revealing an old person huddled behind it, arms crossed tight, hands rubbing together against the cold.

Do you know Shuang'er, the storyteller in town? She's actually Northsnow Manor's master. She's in trouble. There's fighting up there, and she has no one to help her. Please, if there's any way to get me up there, I have to try. For a neighbor.
You try to bow in the Eastian manner, but the elder stops you with a gentle hand.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Oh, child... How young are you? Heroes, quests, the "martial world"... that's just stories for wide-eyed kids. This blizzard isn't a story. It's a killer. The roads won't last much longer. You should be heading home, not up a mountain.
It's not a story. I'm telling the truth. The martial world, it's... it's happening right now. Those heroes—
You hesitate mid-sentence, suddenly uncertain if you can still call those Sinners "heroes." The old man shakes his head slowly as the door closes.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Heroes... Seen plenty of them come and go. Not a single one ever stayed to help us split firewood or patch roofs. Fairy tales, child. Just fairy tales...
[Mountaintop Cliff]

Having just swallowed a priceless Nine-Turn Yang Pill, Shen Wanchou feels its power course through him. His face flushes with vitality as internal force surges, making his presence even stronger than it was upon entering the manor. He snaps his folding fan open and seizes the initiative.

Jichuan's face, by contrast, is deathly pale. Each ragged breath scrapes like knives against her lungs. Unyielding, she grips the scroll in her left hand while her right wields the plum branch in rapid, flowing strikes. In the confined space, she weaves an impenetrable net of defense, deflecting his fan attacks one after another.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Quite the impressive showing. That fierce strength carries Ma Ling's signature. And that flowing motion... Xu Shen's technique? From whom... did you "acquire" such arts?

Malice flashes in Shen Wanchou's eyes. His fan snaps shut with a violent tremor and a sharp, metallic ring before instantly disintegrating into twelve gleaming blades that streak through the air like a sudden downpour.

steps.speaker: Shen Wanchou
steps.content: Ask them yourself when you see them in hell, Manor Master!

Clink, clink, clink. Twelve sharp impacts ring out in rapid succession. Jichuan dodges through the flashing steel, her plum branch sweeping aside most of the blades, though several still graze her shoulder and waist. Fabric tears, and blood blooms on her skin.

Shen Wanchou grins, a malicious curl to his lips, as he gestures with his fingers. The twelve blades obey, whistling back through the air to reassemble into a steel whip with a series of clicks. This legendary weapon—forged at immeasurable cost—now strikes at her legs like a venomous serpent.

Knowing she cannot fully evade, Jichuan grits her teeth and lets the tip bite deep into bone. Then, with a violent twist of her waist, she uses the whip's own momentum to yank herself toward him. The fierce desperation in the move catches Shen Wanchou off guard, and in an instant, she closes the distance. Her plum branch darts out, finding the vital points on his chest and abdomen.
[Foot of the Mountain]
You approach the next house. The door soon flies open to reveal a woman with a sickly, pallid complexion, a baby clutched in her arms.
Hello, I—

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: We don't have anything. My baby hasn't eaten in three days. Try another house.
Before you can get a word out, she begins to shut the door. You react instantly, jamming your hand against it.

Wait, I'm not asking for food. Please. I just need to know if any road to Northsnow Manor is still open. You know Shuang'er, the storyteller in town? She's up there, and she's in real danger. I'm trying to get to her.

The baby in the woman's arms starts crying, its wails thin and reedy. She pats it hurriedly, and as she moves, her sleeve pulls back to reveal a wrist that is nothing but skin and bone. Despite her frailty, she clearly knows Shuang'er.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Heh... You're one of those people, chasing heroes. My husband was like you. Thought if he learned a few moves, he could be a big hero and protect us all. Then the avalanche hit. He ran right into it to "save people"... When we found him, he was frozen hard as a rock.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Don't go up to that manor. That "heroism" you're chasing? It's just a fancy word that gets people killed.
The door slams shut with a heavy thud, its echo giving way to muffled sobbing and the baby's feeble cries from within.
[Mountaintop Cliff]
The power of Shen Wanchou's Nine-Turn Yang Pill ebbs away. Jichuan moves to regulate her breathing, only to find a heavy weakness spreading through her limbs and bones.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: After three breaths of my Intoxicated Dream Powder, your internal force should be scattered to the winds by now. Hehe... your vitality fades, your spirit dims. Those divine arts are wasted on a dying flame. Why not gift them to this old man instead? Consider it the last worthy deed of your existence!

His long staff quivers, its tip arrowing straight for the Zhangmen pressure point beneath Jichuan's ribs. Gritting her teeth, she forces out every last wisp of her remaining internal force and darts to the right.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Stepping north seals your fate, little manor master. Your next step treads upon empty air!

At his words, Jichuan's left foot quickly recoils, her forward momentum halted mid-motion. It is almost enough. Hampered by her injuries, she is a half-beat too slow, and the long stick finds its mark, slicing a bloody line across her ankle.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Tougher than this old man expected, aren't you? No matter. I'll break you down myself, bone by bone, and drain you dry. You'll make a finer tonic than any pill!

His sleeves whip outward, hurling a massive cloud of dark green poison powder directly at her face! But Jichuan, unexpectedly, does not dodge or retreat. Holding her breath in complete focus, she drives her plum branch straight through the toxic mist!

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Still fighting, with death staring you in the face? To become sustenance for my immortal ascent... that's a fortune you should be grateful for!

In his fury, he holds nothing back. His staff technique transforms completely. The dark ebony stick becomes a storm of overlapping shadows, like ravenous spirits clawing for prey, like writhing dragons churning the waters.

Jichuan retreats step by step, snow exploding beneath her feet. New wounds tear across her shoulders, arms, and waist, staining her white robes crimson. Yet her plum branch defense holds firm, and against this storm-like assault, she stubbornly maintains her ground within three feet of the cliff's edge.
Though her body wavers, her spine remains straight.
[Foot of the Mountain]
The door of the third house hangs half-collapsed.

As you approach, about to speak, a faint, putrid smell reaches your nose. Peering inside, you see it: in the corner of the room, on a straw mat, a grayish-blue hand protrudes from beneath a tattered blanket.
Before you can react, an aged, hoarse voice speaks from behind.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: That's Old Liu. Froze to death ten days back. Nobody's got the strength left to put him in the ground.
Why?

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Look around, child. Who's left in Northwild? Old folks, sick folks, the ones who can't run. The young ones either fled to other parts of Eastia, or got scooped up by those martial arts types with all their flashy talk.
Her gaze drifts to the sword at your waist, and realization fills her eyes.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Ah. You're one of them, aren't you? One of those "martial world" folks. Always yapping about being the strongest, cutting each other down over nothing. You young people... always making trouble, never fixing any.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: Just last week, that inn down by the mountain pass? Couple of fighters tore it apart and smashed everything. That family'll be lucky to make it through winter now.

steps.speaker: Old Woman
steps.content: So, what were you gonna ask me, child? ...Hey. Where are you going?
The martial world you long to return to, the truth you seek so desperately—to these people fighting just to survive, they are nothing more than another blizzard to be weathered.

You turn and walk away. The roads after the snow prove far more treacherous than expected. Snow is churned by people and livestock, now a slush of mud and debris, frozen into a filthy, jagged sheet of ice. You slip and fall several times before fighting your way back to your feet.

You finally reach the corner where Shuang'er used to lean against the wall telling stories. It is now only broken walls and crumbling ruins, empty and desolate. The heavy snow falls steadily, inch by inch, erasing every last trace.
[Mountaintop Cliff]

Seeing Yin Yansheng's assault fail, Ji Guining strikes her pipa. The sound waves that erupt are not heard but felt, needles driving directly into the mind, granting no respite. Jichuan is already moving, her dodge calculated. She evades the full force of it, though a thin strand of hair, severed from her temple, marks how close the call truly was.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Three people, one scroll... I find myself wondering... how precisely do you intend to divide it amongst yourselves?

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: You needn't trouble yourself over such matters, Miss Jiang. Once you're gone, we'll settle accounts amongst ourselves.

Jichuan twists to dodge once more, but the rock crumbles underfoot. She lurches forward, her heel skidding off the edge as she nearly plummets into the abyss. With a violent jerk, she flings herself back onto solid rock. She looks down in time to see the debris she kicked free vanish into the silent mist.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Don't deceive yourself. That is a deadly abyss where even birds fall broken-winged. That young friend of yours... by now, is likely nothing but dust and bone.
Jichuan squeezes her eyes shut, forcing her focus inward as she channels the last of her internal force against the demonic sound's assault. Still, the color drains from her face.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: You know, I have always held a certain admiration for you. A body ravaged by affliction, yet you insist on playing the righteous hero. Such a pity that every performance must eventually reach its final act.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Surrender the secret codex. I can grant you a swift death and send you tumbling down to join him. Compared to falling into Doctor Yin's hands, becoming one of his test subjects, or being tortured by Young Master Shen... this is already an act of considerable mercy. Don't you agree, Manor Master Jiang?
steps.female_content: Surrender the secret codex. I can grant you a swift death and send you tumbling down to join her. Compared to falling into Doctor Yin's hands, becoming one of his test subjects, or being tortured by Young Master Shen... this is already an act of considerable mercy. Don't you agree, Manor Master Jiang?

steps.content: The pipa's sound suddenly surges to a piercing crescendo, like ten thousand ghosts wailing in chorus. Jichuan's face turns deathly pale. Blood trickles from the corner of her mouth, and the plum branch nearly slips from her grasp.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Almost... time...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: If I keep taking their attacks, I'll expose a fatal opening within ten moves.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I might as well... take the initiative.
With a flick of her wrist, she releases the scroll of the Snowquell Arts. It sails through the air in a perfect arc, landing precisely in the space between Ji Guining, Shen Wanchou, and Yin Yansheng.

For an instant, all three stand frozen, greed a raw flame in their eyes, before they hurl themselves forward simultaneously! The wind howls and snow swirls as the secret codex tumbles through the air, dancing between their crushing palm strikes and whistling blade shades.

United against an enemy only moments before, they now turn on each other with the fury of sworn foes. Yin Yansheng's poison palm slams into the small of Shen Wanchou's back; Shen Wanchou's fan blade arcs toward Ji Guining's wrist; and Ji Guining, fingers dancing across her strings, sends three sonic blades tearing through the air to find Yin Yansheng's throat.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Fight... seize it... Use those hands stained with innocent blood to claim this scroll... my personally crafted gut-piercing poison...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Use those hearts that schemed against your closest companions... to second-guess each other... How much humanity... can possibly remain...

Yin Yansheng risks his left shoulder to take Shen Wanchou's fan strike. Bone cracks, but in that same instant, his right hand shoots out and seizes the codex. He bursts into wild laughter, though his triumph barely lasts a heartbeat—

Shen Wanchou's folding fan separates again, twelve cold blades raining down like iron hail, blanketing the sky! Yin Yansheng roars, swinging his crutch in a desperate block, but his chest remains wide open. A thin blade, originally meant for Ji Guining, curves back through the air and finds his heart with a wet thud.
The Immortal Healer freezes mid-motion. He stares down at the crimson blooming across his chest, staggers a few steps, and crumples into the snow.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Your enemies... are not merely each other, and not merely me. Down the mountain, vengeful spirits await to collect blood debts. Behind you lurk allies watching like starving tigers... And in your hearts lie insatiable hunger, endless greed, and delusions of immortality...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Like scavenging flies and dogs fighting over carrion, claws and fangs bared in this bitter storm. All claim to know a secret path to heaven... yet it is nothing but another fleeting dream.
Shen Wanchou darts forward, kicking aside Yin Yansheng's still-warm corpse and snatching the codex. A flash of wild joy crosses his face, but behind him, Ji Guining begins to stir in her wheelchair.

Her lameness turns out to be all a ruse! The Princess rises with ghostly swiftness. Before Shen Wanchou can even react, she materializes before him, her fingers already dancing across the pipa's strings.

He evades the sonic blade and tries to curse, but the sound dies in his throat into a wet gurgle. He looks down in dawning horror to find Ji Guining's short sword, hidden beneath the pipa, already buried deep in his neck.
[Foot of the Mountain]

One house, two houses, three houses... You walk through half the town, and every answer is the same: there is no path. There is no hope. No one believes in heroes anymore. Maybe there is still a way to reach the manor, but if people's hearts won't turn toward it, how can such a path ever be opened?

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: ...Hello?

A thin, quavering voice, strangely clear, suddenly speaks from beside you. You look down to find a girl in a worn cotton jacket, her small face flushed from the cold. She looks up, and her eyes are bright and sparkling.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: You... wait, you're that young hero! The one who listened to stories with me by the road that day! I remember you! Your sword! Your robe!
The child tugs at the hem of your clothes, her voice quivering with barely contained excitement.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: A real martial arts master! Just like in Shuang'er's stories! The ones who run across rooftops and jump over walls! You're here to help us, right? Tell me you're here to help!
You open your mouth, but your mind goes blank, unable to find the words.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: Then quick, check if I've got it! The hero stuff! Shuang'er says I do, but I... I can't see it at all!

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: She says big fists like clay pots and little fists like mine, they all got their own strength! Hiya! Pow pow pow! They can chase away all the bad things and the big scary troubles!
Big fists, little fists... Aren't these the words that old friend of Jichuan's, Mudling, left behind?
What else has Shuang'er told you?

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: So much stuff! But my favorite's her own stories. The ones about her in the martial world!
Her own stories?
You kneel beside her. Only now do you see that the child's bulk comes from layers of torn rags and old clothes, a poor padding against the cold. You pull the fabric snug around her small frame.
On the far end of the shackles, Jichuan's life force continues to fade. The decisive battle out in the snow is reaching its end.
I'd really like to hear those. The stories about her. Could you tell me?
[Mountaintop Cliff]
A fountain of crimson erupts from Shen Wanchou's neck. He crumples, his lifeblood pooling with the fallen plum petals on the ground. The scroll lands silently beside his jade-inlaid boots.
At last, the divine arts are in Ji Guining's hands. She seizes the scroll, lifts it high in victory, and tips her head back, her laughter ringing out in triumph.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Ancestors above, bear witness! The mandate to rebuild, the restoration of my homeland... Heaven has delivered it at last into my hands! Hahaha... This is fate! Honor among heroes? Covenants of the martial world? Before true power, they are nothing but stepping stones beneath my feet!

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Manor Master Jiang, I thank you for your generous gift. Once I have unraveled the mysteries within, I shall see to it that you receive... a most modest grave. Now, let the first soul claimed by the "divine arts" serve as a blood sacrifice to my destiny!
Leaning against the jagged rocks at the cliff's edge, Jichuan is covered in wounds and breathes with difficulty. But at the sight of Ji Guining's triumph, a soft chuckle suddenly escapes her.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Hahaha... How peculiar you all are.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: You hunger for power so desperately. You rely on it, trade it for hollow fame, fleeting fortune, the illusion of dominion... yet you understand nothing of what power truly is. You willingly let corruption seep into your very bones, all for the sake of a beautiful mask.
Ji Guining has no patience for the ravings of a defeated foe. With eager hands, her focus narrows to the threads wrapped around the codex, her fingers working to untie the knots.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: In such a hurry... but have you forgotten? I mentioned I still have an old score to settle with you...

Before she can finish speaking, Ji Guining tears open the scroll. She doesn't even have a moment to read the script before a churning mass of inky, black energy erupts from it, its tendrils lancing straight toward her eyes.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: Aghh—! What... what is this?!
Each laugh sends pain shooting through her wounds, making it difficult for Jichuan to continue. Gathering what little strength she has left, she slowly rises to her feet.

Snowflakes fall like scattered jade, blotting out the sun and sky. She has only been watching the drama unfold at the cliff's edge for what feels like a moment, but when she stands, she finds herself buried in snow.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I am not like you, no vast networks, no reach across the martial world. I have had a few friends in this life. But there was one person... We made a promise: once we both became accomplished people, we would meet again. I had searched for her for many years.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: She was skilled and kind-hearted. By the standards of this martial world, she should have become a renowned hero. Yet I had searched every corner of Northwild and found no trace of her. Guess what I discovered instead?
She brushes the clinging flower petals from her clothes, her smile fading into something cold.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Not long after my friend vanished without a trace, a number of people in the Northwild martial world suddenly displayed exceptional talent. Miraculous encounters, powers soaring overnight. Gradually, these same people carved up the martial world among themselves and became the ones who dictate its rules.

Ji Guining has now collapsed to her knees in the snow. The vile thing from the codex, having devoured her eyes, now rages through her bloodstream. It clashes violently with her internal force, inflicting an agony beyond anything she has ever known.

steps.speaker: Ji Guining
steps.content: My organs burning... meridians boiling... What... what have you done?!
[Foot of the Mountain]

You listen as a child speaks, her voice dripping with innocence, telling you how Shuang'er came to town ten years ago. She presented herself as an associate of the Beggar Clan, disappearing for long stretches, only to return with stories from all over Northwild for everyone. Every location Shuang'er mentioned aligns perfectly with the sects named in the criminal records.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: You wanna know the best part? Shuang'er is amazing. Like, super amazing. She sneaked into every big martial arts place in Northwild! And she brought back these incredible <color=#fb9259>treasures</color>! From all of them! But she's so stingy. She hides 'em all and buries 'em real deep. Won't even let me peek. Not even a little peek...!
Treasures? What kind of treasures?

The child suddenly clamps a hand over your mouth, as if you're about to divulge some earth-shattering secret. Then, with a mysterious air, she grabs your hand and pulls you into a run toward the town entrance.
You follow her all the way to the edge of Ping'an Town, to the barren ground behind the candy shop, where six small mounds of earth sit crooked and askew.

steps.speaker: Child A
steps.content: See? Shuang'er came here lots of times! Took her forever to find 'em all and put 'em here. She said these are super duper important! Like, the most important things ever! And when she finds all of them, she'll figure out... the biggest, deepest secret in the whole entire martial world!

The closer you move, the more distinctly you feel the uneasy tremors radiating from the shackles. Below the surface, a faintly familiar presence stirs... It echoes the feeling you had when you first arrived in Northwild, during the fight at the inn.

Their power is somewhat different from DisCity Sinners... I can't quite put my finger on it, but it feels purer and more unified. Perhaps this is the "internal force" mentioned in the materials you gave me?
The six mounds before you appear randomly scattered, but a closer look reveals a deliberate design: head, torso, limbs. They are arranged to trace the outline of a small human figure.
[Mountaintop Cliff]

Ji Guining crouches on the ground, her hands desperately clamped over her mouth and nose. It is no use; pitch-black branches still force their way through the flesh between her fingers, writhing and twisting outward. Their surfaces are studded with slimy, tumor-like nodes, as if something living has taken root in her very bones and blood.
Jichuan watches her struggle with cold, impassive eyes, slowly raising the broken staff in her hand.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: It took considerable time to track down those heroes from years past, one by one. To spread the rumor of a secret codex, and to lure you all here, to this manor.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I went to such lengths because I harbored a faint, almost foolish hope. That perhaps, in this filthy martial world, there might still exist half a person with a conscience. To harm the innocent would betray the very principle of justice my friend and I once swore to uphold. She would surely reproach me for it, from where she now lies.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: But it seems the romantic ideals of heroism are, and always were, merely fairy tales for children. Those who believe in "ascension in one step," and those who wear the virtuous mask of a hero while they exploit the desperate... they are cut from the same cloth. For that clarity, I have you all to thank. Through your very presence here, you have dispelled the last of my naivety. It turns out...

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Every single one of you deserves to die.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: A single blade... can only claim a single life. Can it dismantle the very foundation of this corrupt system? This system that views the weak as nothing more than weeds to be trampled?

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: What I seek... is never a simple accounting of lives. I intend to tear away the gilded veil from this so-called "heroism," this doctrine of might-makes-right. I want everyone to witness the filth and decay festering beneath the principles you claim to uphold and the power you fight over.
She takes a deep breath.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: What I aim to destroy is this unjust order that has plagued Northwild for decades. An order where the Great Seer is made absent, where petty tyrants rule with violence, and the lives of ordinary people are treated as less than nothing!

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Today, this manor shall serve as the altar... Your greed, your hypocrisy, the inevitable consequence of your own deeds... they will be the most fitting confession and epitaph.
[Foot of the Mountain]
Next to the earthen mounds, you finally make out the mottled text on the wooden plaque. This is the tombstone of Mudling, and the mounds her scattered graves.
The ink is faded and weathered, but the brushstrokes remain vigorous. Here, preserved in wood, is the true first denunciation—

Manifesto to the World: In years gone by, atop a silent peak where snow forever lies, a young Seer's form was torn asunder, severed before mortal eyes. They sucked the marrow, devoured the flesh, plundered the spiritual meridians, all for their righteous creed. Now I have gathered what remained and found the power in those bones has never truly died. The departed soul, beholding well this body plagued and weak, has bestowed her final breath on me. This breath I now divide in twain. Yang to mend this broken shell, to steel me for the fight. Yin to merge with tainted poison, turning stolen Seer's power back upon its thieving kind. When Yin and Yang shall clash as one, with blood for sacrifice, the divine shall wake. The red plum's last testament is writ, ending only when the snow clears.
[Mountaintop Cliff]

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: What I demand of you is the blood debt for a child born with a gift. A child who could have grown to be a true hero. A child you... consumed, piece by piece.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Now, you will repay everything you have devoured. The stolen potential, the cultivated power, the ill-gotten reputation, the wealth and status... every last fraction of it, with all the accrued interest. Let it all be returned. Let it fill the wind and snow, let it be a benediction for the living, and a solace for the souls you buried.
